heroHeadline: Pakistan Carries Munir's Letter to Khamenei as BLA Bombing Kills 47 in Quetta
heroSubtitle: Interior Minister Naqvi delivers a special message from Field Marshal Asim Munir to Iran's Supreme Leader as Pakistan deepens its Iran-US mediation role; separately, the BLA's Majeed Brigade killed 47 in a suicide bombing on a Quetta cantonment train and Gilgit-Baltistan held legislative assembly elections with PTI barred from its party symbol.
footerNote: Data sourced from official government records (Government of Pakistan, ECP, SBP, ISPR), major news outlets (Dawn, Reuters, AP, BBC, Al Jazeera), academic institutions, and international organizations (UN, IMF, World Bank, SIPRI, HRCP).
